description.en: LC3 Nakisunga is drilling a borehole in Kigomba village. Works started 10 January 2026. Clean water expected by end of month.
description.lg: LC3 y'e Nakisunga esima oluzzi mu kyalo Kigomba. Emirimu gyatandika nga 10 January 2026. Amazzi amalungi gasuubirwa enkomerero y'omwezi.
description.sw: LC3 ya Nakisunga inachimba kisima kijiji cha Kigomba. Kazi zilianza 10 Januari 2026. Maji safi yanatarajiwa mwisho wa mwezi.

description.en: LC5 Mukono announced grading of the Mpatta feeder road. Works begin February 2026. Report blocked culverts to the sub-county office.
description.lg: LC5 y'e Mukono elangiridde okusengejja oluguudo lwa Mpatta. Emirimu gitandika mu February 2026. Tegeeza kalubyu ezizibye ku offiisi ya ggombolola.
description.sw: LC5 ya Mukono imetangaza kusawazisha barabara ya Mpatta. Kazi zinaanza Februari 2026. Ripoti makalavati yaliyoziba kwa ofisi ya tarafa.

title.lg: Okuyonja kasasiro okuva ku lunju mu Makindye
title.sw: Ukusanyaji taka mlango hadi mlango Makindye

description.en: KCCA Makindye division starts door-to-door waste pickup on parish schedules. Bag waste and put it out on your parish morning. Missed pickup: call the division office.
description.lg: Divizoni ya KCCA e Makindye etandika okuyonja kasasiro okuva ku lunju ng'enteekateeka z'emiruka bwe ziri. Teeka kasasiro mu bupaveera era ogufulumye ku makya g'omuluka gwo. Bwe gatalonjjebwa: kubira offiisi ya divizoni.
description.sw: Divisheni ya KCCA Makindye inaanza ukusanyaji taka mlango hadi mlango kwa ratiba za parishi. Funga taka na uziweke nje asubuhi ya parishi yako. Ukikosa: pigia ofisi ya divisheni.

description.en: KCCA Kawempe division completed repair of street lights on the main road. Report dark spots to the division office for the next round.
description.lg: Divizoni ya KCCA e Kawempe emalirizza okuddaabiriza taala z'oluguudo olunene. Tegeeza ebifo ebirimu ekizikiza ku offiisi ya divizoni ku ludda oluddako.
description.sw: Divisheni ya KCCA Kawempe imekamilisha ukarabati wa taa za barabara kuu. Ripoti sehemu zenye giza kwa ofisi ya divisheni kwa awamu inayofuata.
